title: fix(plugin-grid): ObjectGrid projects the row colour's field (objectui#12393)
body:
Fixes #12393
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ObjectGrid`'s own `$select` (`getSelectFields` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`) gains a row-colour arm, `rowColorFields`, unioned with the predicate operands, grouping fields and concurrency token. It goes through the same two gates those fields use: `isProjectableField` (a declared field or a platform column) first, then `passesProjectionGate` (FLS). A grid that fetches its own rows now asks for `rowColor.field` even when no column shows it, so `useRowColor` finds `row[field]` and tints the row. This covers a standalone `object-grid` and a grouped list view whose data source answers `queryGroupHeaders` (`gridOwnsGroupedFetch`). It is the grid half of objectui#12376 (PR #12392).

There is no validator and no lint refusal. The spec sets no column requirement on `rowColor.field`.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1 holds.** `getSelectFields` had no `rowColor` arm, and `useRowColor(schema.rowColor)` paints from `row[field]`. Before the fix, the ablation below turns the new standalone pin red: `$select` has no `is_escalated`, and the row has no tint.
- **A2 holds, and the dependency is added.** `ListView` hands the grid its toolbar pick as `rowColor` (`rowColorConfig`), so `schema.rowColor` can change while no other dependency does. The fetch effect now names `rowColorField`, a string read from `schema.rowColor?.field`. A rule that names a new field re-reads the rows. A change to the `colors` map alone costs no request. This follows the objectui#10689 precedent. ListView's own effect skips the dependency because both pickers offer only the columns (the 12376 pin's last row checks that). A host that rewrites the grid's `rowColor` directly has no such guarantee.
- **A3 holds.** The enumeration pin is behavioural, not a source grep. It mounts `ListView` with one binding of every harvest arm, keeps the node it hands a stub grid and the `$select` of its own window fetch, then renders the real `ObjectGrid` with that node and reads the `$select` of its group row pages.

## Tests

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowColorProjection-12393.test.tsx`, standalone grid, 6 tests:
  - a non-column field is projected and the matching row is tinted;
  - a field that is also a column is sent once;
  - an FLS-denied field and an undeclared field are not sent;
  - every server-grouped group page carries the field;
  - the rows are re-read on a new field and not on a colours-only change.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.gridRowColorSelect-12393.test.tsx`, beside `ListView.rowColorSelect-12376`:
  - a grouped grid tinted by `tier`, which is not a column, asks for it on its group pages and tints the row;
  - **the family pin**: every grid binding `ListView` projects (column, grouping, row colour, conditionalFormatting operand, rowActionDefs `visible` and `recordIdField`, bulkActionDefs, object actions, object `userActions`, concurrency token), `ObjectGrid` projects too. The difference must equal an explicit allow-list, `NOT_GRID_BINDINGS`.
- The plugin-list file imports the real grid by path (`../../../plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid`) because plugin-list declares no dependency on plugin-grid. Precedent: the app-shell `currentUserCan-*` render tests. `check:phantom-deps` reads 0, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` lists both files.

**Ablation**, run once via `ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores on exit; it read back `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The mutation replaced `...concurrencyFields, ...rowColorFields];` with `...concurrencyFields /* ABLATED-12393 */];` (anchor 1 to 0). Result: 5 failed, 3 passed across the two files. The family pin read `expected [ 'due_date', 'stage', 'tier' ] to deeply equal [ 'due_date', 'stage' ]`. The first attempt (replacement `];`) was refused by the tool before any test ran, because the replacement count did not rise. It was a no-op and was redone with a distinct marker. A second ablation removed `rowColorField` from the effect's dependencies: exactly the re-read test went red (1 failed, 5 passed).

## Gates, read at `d1feb1b8b`

- Type-check: `plugin-grid` 0 and `plugin-list` 0, after the closure build `--filter "@object-ui/plugin-grid^..." --filter "@object-ui/plugin-list^..."` (0).
- Vitest, targeted: 17 files, 187 tests, 0 failures. These are the new pins plus the 12376, 6898, 7179, 11105, 7189, 10689, 12292, 12375, prototype-guard, 7215, 11574, recordIdField, 10277, 10404 and ListView 7189 suites.
- Vitest, full plugin-grid under the lock: in 4 shards, 0, 0, 0, 0, for 53+53+51+58 = 215 files, which equals the `git ls-files` count of plugin-grid test files. An unsharded run hit my 560 s foreground timeout (124), so it was sharded. The plugin-list package suite was not run in full: `ListView.tsx` is untouched, and only the 12376 pin, the 7189 hand-off pin and the new file ran. That is declared as a narrowing.
- Lint on the 3 changed files: `eslint` 0 errors. `--no-inline-config` reads 1 error, the existing `react-hooks/static-components` at the authored empty icon. The base file reads the same 1 error and 215 warnings, so the diff adds none to `ObjectGrid.tsx`.
- The check battery reads 0 on all of these: phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, new-line-citations, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`.
- `check:spec-floors` reads 1 ("The scan collapsed"). It is red on main too, objectui#12334, and is not touched here.

## Acceptance notes

- The family pin's allow-list holds one class today. `ListView` collects the kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline, gantt and map blocks into `$select` whatever the current view kind, so a grid view carrying those blocks fetches their fields. The grid draws none of them and owes them nothing, so the pin allow-lists them (`stage`, `due_date`) with that reason. No other binding was missing from the grid.
- Bound of the family pin: it sees only the inputs it feeds. A new `ListView` harvest arm that reads a key `FULL_VIEW` does not carry is invisible to it until a fixture row is added. The test header says so.
- Published surface: no export, prop or type member moves. `rowColor` was already on `ObjectGridSchema`.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
